'''Kev Barstere''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident. 

== Activities ==
He [[Travel]]s through [[Jur Grady]]'s [[Gateway]] to join the rest of the [[Two Rivers]] men taken by [[Perrin Aybara]]. He participates in the [[Battle of Malden]].
